historical_references.reference: Ayanaan was a celebrated Tamil poet in the Sangam period, which roughly spans from 200 BC to 200 AD. He is best known for his works in the Agam literature, which includes various genres like love poetry, war poetry, and pastoral poetry. Ayanaan's most famous work is 'Agananuru', a collection of 106 poems.

Ayanaan, also known as Agastya Muni, is considered one of the Sapta Rishis or Seven Sages in Hindu mythology. He is believed to have lived during the Treta Yuga and authored several important Hindu texts, including the 'Agastya Samhita' and 'Agastya Nigama'. Ayanaan is also revered for his travels across the Indian subcontinent and his contributions to the spread of Hinduism.
